verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs claim a GPU with a 2x faster hardware ray-tracing engine and say games like Control 'look more compelling', so there is a vendor gaming claim. However, Apple gives no frame-rate figures, and the pack has no independent game benchmarks to corroborate it; the one gaming-adjacent community comment is about Unreal Engine game development, not play frame rates. Missing for 10: independent game benchmarks with frame rates, vendor frame-rate or boost/cache gaming claims, and hands-on gaming reports.

support.subject: As a gamer, this chip drives high frame rates in real games — vendor gaming claims (cache, boost behavior, integrated GPU class) corroborated by independent game benchmarks

citations.quote: with the improved hardware-accelerated ray-tracing engine in the M4 family GPU, games like Control look more compelling
The GPUs build on the breakthrough graphics architecture introduced in the previous generation, with faster cores and a 2x faster ray-tracing engine.
